confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few undated or partly crowd-sourced guides and menus (2023 to 2026) that conflict on mid-range meals; the inexpensive-meal and cocktail anchors have the most agreement. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no search performed. The FX observation is the 2026-03-20 figure from the search summary, which I could not confirm as the latest observation for 2026-11-19. I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Food and drink anchors are benchmarked on Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe-side tourist menus and budget guides, with Harare figures used for local meal prices. Accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge of Victoria Falls town lodging tiers, not from live listings.
